confidence_notes: Meals are informed by [current Numbeo prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Bilbao) and a [June 2026 snapshot](https://www.expatica.com/es/cost-of-living/bilbao/). Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain: they are roughly three times and slightly above the beer price, respectively, consistent with local [cocktail](https://cadenaser.com/euskadi/2026/01/15/donde-se-paga-un-vermut-a-16-euros-buscamos-precios-en-bilbao-tras-la-polemica-de-getxo-radio-bilbao/) and [wine](https://bilbaotravelguide.com/guides/bilbao-wine-bars-guide/) reports. Accommodation is a seasonal model estimate and can vary substantially around events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on northern Spanish city costs, with a July tourism premium and less accommodation pressure than San Sebastián.
